problems: union-of-utrecht is typed rebel (the northern provinces against the king of Spain, 1579 to the Act of Abjuration of 26 July 1581); a reviewer who prefers state may retype it, nothing else changes.

Every Cliopatria Dutch Republic and Union of Utrecht shape contains one stray cell at Orange in Provence, and the Dutch Republic shapes from 1600 carry overseas company and colony cells (3 to 900 cells per shape); all keyframes are clipped to 300 km of the Low Countries, so the overseas cells without a colony dossier (Coromandel, Bengal, Malabar, Mauritius, Gorée; Timor, Aru and Kai inside the Indonesia cluster) vanish from the map until dossiers exist.
dutch-republic start stays 1582 (Cliopatria) although the Act of Abjuration is 26 July 1581 and the page dates the Republic to the instruction of 12 April 1588; a reviewer may prefer 1588.

duchy-of-prussia ends 1618 although the legal entity lasted to 1701 (Polish fief to 1657): Cliopatria's Brandenburg-Prussia row takes the land from 1619 and contains all of it, so ending the duchy in 1618 avoids drawing the land twice.
habsburg-netherlands is the counterpart of every gain in the Union of Utrecht and Dutch Republic dossiers 1579-1713 and has no Cliopatria row and no dossier; the slug is the one this batch uses.
The 1672 invasion is modelled as occupation (hatched), not as the 35-cell loss in Cliopatria's 1673-76 shapes; only Maastricht (30 June 1673, back in 1678-08 at confidence 1) is a loss.
The Flanders_campaign URL is a disambiguation page (counted among the 14 Dutch Republic pages, kept in sources with a note) and the Peace of Munster page is thin; no page failed to load.

Resolver warnings are only unknown gazetteer names (about 35 for dutch-republic, 3 for union-of-utrecht, 0 for duchy-of-prussia); every other check passes and all three dossiers validate with 0 errors.
